full_judgment: 2. The suit for declaration of title and plaintiff's case, in short, is that suit land was purchased by Kafiron Bibi on 25.10.1922 by registered sale deed No.5159, by sale deed No.903 dated 28.02.1924 and registered sale deed No.5284 dated 08.11.1922 from C.S. recorded tenants and took possession of the same. Kafiron Bibi enjoying the land in question by exercising all acts of possession thereon. Kafiron Bibi died, leaving son Noor Mohammad Mondal as her heir who also enjoyed the land in question by exercising all acts of possession and during his peaceful possession on 20th Ashsin, 1349 B.S. transferred the said land in favour of his wife, Mofizan Bewa, plaintiff, in exchange of her dower money and since then Mofizan Bewa possessing the suit land in question through her husband but beyond her knowledge, S.A. and R.S. record of right of the land were prepared in the name of her husband, Noor Mohammad Mondal. Noor Mohammad Mondal died in 1971 leaving, Mofiza Bewa and his 2nd wife and other defendants as his heirs. At the end of Magh, 1405 B.S. defendants approached the plaintiff and demanded partition of the land in question as heirs of Noor Mohammad Mondal by dint of R.S. khatians prepared in the name of Noor Mohammad Mondal. Plaintiff after obtaining certified copy of R.S. khatian on 11.01.1999 came to know the erroneous preparation and publication of S.A. and R.S. khatians, hence the suit.
